hero.title: VoiceStick
hero.lead: A compact voice stick based on M5Stack StickS3. It connects to macOS or Windows over BLE, uses Alibaba Cloud DashScope real-time speech recognition by default, can switch to existing Doubao-related ASR support, and turns live feedback into text at your cursor.

ble.title: Low-power BLE
ble.body: Pair the StickS3 in your hand over Bluetooth Low Energy. It is wireless, efficient, and ready to stay on your desk or travel with your laptop.

model.title: Alibaba Cloud real-time ASR
model.body: VoiceStick uses Alibaba Cloud DashScope real-time speech recognition by default for fast everyday dictation.

feedback.title: Live text feedback
feedback.body: Recognition appears as live feedback on screen, then the final text is confirmed before it is inserted into the current input field.

story.title: Pick it up to speak. Put it down to keep writing.
story.body: VoiceStick turns M5Stack StickS3 into a dedicated voice input button. Keep it near your keyboard, slip it into a pocket, or carry it with your laptop. Hold to talk, and the recognized text comes back to your cursor.

flasher.title: Flash firmware online
flasher.body: Use Chrome or Edge to write the latest Release firmware to M5Stack StickS3 over USB serial. The firmware comes from GitHub Releases, so no local flashing tools are required.

steps.usb: Connect the StickS3 to your computer with USB-C.
steps.boot: If connection fails, hold the side reset button until the internal green LED blinks, then release it.
steps.flash: Click start and choose the StickS3 USB serial port.

firmware.latest: VoiceStick StickS3 firmware will be fetched from the latest GitHub Release.

flasher.unsupported: This browser does not support Web Serial. Open this page in desktop Chrome or Edge.

log.selectLocal: Release firmware download failed. Choose a local .bin firmware file to continue.

download.title: Need another file?
